phrases.latin: Sed prius tē bene operī; māne frīgus est.
phrases.english: But wrap up warm first; it’s cold in the morning.
phrases.source: Fābula III, Apud avum et aviam

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 116, checked against the searchable text of the book (29 October 2026).
Theodōrus et pater: Fābulae Latīnae ad vītam cotīdiānam I–VII, as revised on 29 October 2026. Examples marked “Fābula” quote those texts word for word.
